aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs also experience daily decay and rebalancing, requiring strict stop discipline.
